parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: Smart Card Type. {{enum}} Vendors can extend the enumerated values with vendor specific extensions, in which case the rules outlined in {{bibref|TR-106|Section 3.3}} MUST be adhered to.

parameters.name: Application
parameters.description: {{list}} Indicates Smart Card Application(s). {{param}} is only relevant when {{param|Type}} has a value of UICC, otherwise it is {{empty}}. {{enum}} Vendors can extend the enumerated values with vendor specific extensions, in which case the rules outlined in {{bibref|TR-106|Section 3.3}} MUST be adhered to.

parameters.name: SerialNumber
parameters.description: The Smart Card Serial Number or {{empty}} if the Smart Card serial Number is not available, e.g. in the case of IPTV due to restrictions of the Service Delivery Platform.

parameters.name: ATR
parameters.description: The Smart Card answer to a reset action. Issued by the Smart Card upon reset.

object.description: Status of currently associated smart card.
